title: Construction Milestone Structural Record
description: Structural milestone graph node. Milestone name, sequence, dates, progress, and construction status belong exclusively in Facts.

id.description: Stable UUID used as the Construction Milestone graph node and Fact relationship target.

schema_version.description: Version of this structural Construction Milestone contract.

entity_type.description: Fixed collection discriminator used for deterministic typed references.

slug.description: Stable repository key; it is not an evidentiary milestone name.

display_name.description: Non-authoritative interface label; never a sourced milestone name.

project_id.description: Structural edge to the Project node containing this milestone.

dependency_milestone_ids.description: Structural edges to prerequisite milestone nodes; schedules and completion remain Facts.

created_at.description: UTC date-time when this structural graph node was created.

modified_at.description: UTC date-time of the latest permitted repository-administration update.

record_status.description: Repository-management state, not construction completion status.

administrative_notes.description: Optional repository-management note containing no asserted construction facts.
